where: Cinderhead Lumenary (Otho Grist's hall at the mine mouth — the difficulty wall)
mood: The mine under pressure — groaning timbers, charged air, a terse staccato motif over a driving low walk; held-breath tension before the wall.
core_styles: A harmonic minor with the raised seventh
terse staccato low pulse-wave and brass motif, recurring like a held breath
nervous fast bell arpeggio flickers in short bursts
driving low synth bass ostinato walking steadily
dry pick-tap percussion and timpani, static noise swells
tense, claustrophobic, stern and determined stone hall deep in a mine

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {the timbers groan: a low timpani roll and two heavy pick strikes, then the driving bass ostinato begins alone, a static swell rising over it}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the terse staccato motif: a clipped rising leap stabbed again and again over the walking bass, the raised seventh sharpening the unease, a stern memorable figure}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the motif again with nervous bell arpeggios flickering in short bursts between its stabs and string stabs on the offbeats, pressure building}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the rock leans in; shift to D minor, the bass slows to half-time, a longer stern brass melody rises over low strings, grim and resolute, then the ostinato resumes}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the staccato motif returns over the driving bass; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
